title: Aquarium (sketch)
description: A fish-tank sketch on the agent-substrate engine: a projected flow in a closed tank (not self-advecting), buoyant heat, a nitrogen-conserving nitrification motif in the filter, and fish, plankton and bubbles. The page says what it does not model.

cogdoc.claim: A layered visual analog of a tank: projected (non-self-advecting) flow in a closed box, buoyant heat and a nitrification motif that conserves nitrogen. Unvetted.

changes: nitrify uptake clamped to min(S, mu*B*mask) in cpu.js and both GPU shaders: total N / ammonia added 205-250x -> 0.93-1.01 (CPU engine, 3 seeds); real page 53x (cpu) and 189x (webgl2) -> 0.89 and 0.94
bubbles: page init is resetAgents then seedAquarium (spec.js setupState), shared by index.html and twin.html; bubbles rise (mean vy about -0.26 cells/step, 3 seeds; before 0)
no-penetration walls in the projection (CPU and GPU): a uniform flow projects to ~0 (rms 9e-6, was 1.0); half-grid tank mean vy -6.3 -> -0.006 after 1500 steps
verdict reads per-cell filter-sponge concentrations; app-level physics runs once per engine step; nitrogen ledger and filter readout in the panel; test port window.__aquarium
page text says what it does not model (self-advection, light column, refraction angle, bacteria step, grid rescaling); tests/aquarium.js added
